label: early-episode a1/S1 after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only early in the episode: 62% of activation mass falls in trials 0-9, 35% in trials 10-19, and it never fires after trial ~30. It is tied to the a1/S1 side: 93% of mass is on trials where the agent chooses a1, and in_state S1 / in_action a1 carry the D2 mass, with almost nothing on a2/S2. It is gated by the absence of reward: it never fires when in_rew = 1, and 89% of mass is on trials whose previous outcome was 0. Activation is largest at D2 when S1 is reached after choosing a1 (55% of mass), weaker at the following unrewarded D1 and at the GO where a1 is chosen. Repeated unrewarded a1 -> S1 trials early in the episode give the highest activations. It is more common in episodes that start with S1 good (86% of mass). The predicate uses only observed variables plus the agent own upcoming choice at GO. Precision is low (~0.33) because many early unrewarded a1 steps do not cross the threshold. This looks like a slowly decaying early-episode state that the timing/streak conditions only roughly capture.
